question: Who among the following became the Chief Minister of Tripura in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manik Saha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manik Saha** became the **Chief Minister of Tripura **in **May 2022.**
 
• He is a member of the C**ommunist Party of India (Marxist)** and was elected as the leader of the party in the state assembly.
 
• Prior to his appointment as Chief Minister, **Saha** served as the Deputy Chief Minister of Tripura.
 
• It is worth noting that the Chief Minister of Tripura,** Biplab Kumar Deb,** resigned from his post on **May 3, 2022, c**iting personal reasons.
 
• Manik Saha was elected as his successor on** May 9, 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asish Das** is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP**) and a former **MLA** from the **Barjala constituency in Tripura**.

 
 
• He was the Minister of** Housing and Urban Development** in the previous BJP-led government in the state.
 
 
 
• **Malina Debnath** is a member of the **Indigenous People's Front of Tripura (IPFT)** and was elected as an **MLA** from the reserved constituency of **Kadamtala-Kurti** in the** 2018** assembly elections.
